place.title: Place {ref} ({prop.color} LED)
place.text: Push the {prop.color} LED {ref} into the breadboard: {list}.
place.tip: The long leg is + (anode). The short leg is − (cathode), on the side where the LED's rim is flat.

why: An LED only lets current flow one way, from the long leg (+) to the short leg (−). Placed this way round, {ref} lights up when its pin turns on.

wire.ground: This completes {ref}'s circuit: current flows from its pin, through the resistor and the LED, and back to ground here.
